gates.requiredScope: Validate the active Feature 005 run state, exact branch, accepted Analyze-entry hashes, current Analyze-remediated artefact hashes bound through analyze-remediation.md and analyze.result.json, current Ready intake review, and GSDB eligibility before every semantic or delivery phase.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Before every semantic phase or delivery action and after any branch, head, intake, review, series, authority, or run-state change.

gates.requiredScope: Validate all completed structured phase results against schema 1.0, their exact phase IDs, normalized payload hashes, zero executed implementation-task counts for pre-implementation phases including Analyze, and 131/131 only for terminal Implement without treating any earlier phase completion as run completion.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any phase payload/result change and at each phase boundary.

gates.requiredScope: Prove the current GSDB 3.2.0 source inventory, normalized hashes, twelve checklist families, exact canonical ID set and 157 observed unique IDs, including related, learning, managed-reference, constitution, registry, preset, workflow, validator, and project-evidence sources.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any GSDB, constitution, registry, preset, workflow, validator, evidence, or intake-source change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove that the generated compendium contains exactly the canonical 157 IDs once each and that every canonical checklist content block matches its compendium block; any mismatch becomes a finding.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any individual checklist, compendium, generator, or baseline-manifest change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove repeatable RED for a fresh missing path and all declared invalid fixtures, the smallest valid helper GREEN, and full GREEN for the complete production matrix through both PowerShell and Bash entrypoints.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After schema, validator, fixture, checklist, source, or CI workflow changes.

gates.requiredScope: Validate exactly 157 complete checklist assessments, two-axis status semantics, learning stage, concrete evidence locators, owners, reviewers, follow-up, expected evidence, target dates, triggers, residual risks, findings, and zero unsupported Human-only approvals.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any matrix, evidence, reviewer, finding, or summary change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove every guideline or related-document duty outside checklist coverage is assessed, all thirteen installed presets are mapped to checkpoints, old six/seven-preset wording is classified, and reused Feature 004 evidence has current scope/freshness locators.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After guideline, related-document, preset, Feature 004 evidence, mapping, or freshness changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove explicit NIST SSDF and CWE Top 25 coverage against the TinyCalc lifecycle, formula/input, error, file-I/O, dependency, and delivery evidence without any N/A disposition.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After product, lifecycle, weakness-list, security-evidence, or baseline changes.

gates.requiredScope: Assess C# memory-safety status together with secure API, input, deserialization, error, path, file-I/O, dependency and native-boundary rules; no product hardening or blanket security claim is allowed.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After source, language, runtime, API, native dependency, input, error, or I/O changes.

gates.requiredScope: Reassess current context, building-block, runtime and deployment views; four trust-boundary groups; CIA, STRIDE, CAPEC; Defense in Depth; Least Privilege; Fail-Safe Defaults; Attack Surface Reduction; separation of security concerns; secure configuration; arc42 security concepts; quality scenarios; technical debt; and ADR/S-ADR non-applicability without changing product architecture.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After architecture, data-flow, trust-boundary, integration, deployment, threat, or quality-attribute changes.

gates.requiredScope: Execute OWASP ASVS verification for a Web, API, HTTP, authentication, authorization, or remotely reachable product service.
gates.rationale: TinyCalc is an unchanged local Terminal.Gui application and this assessment introduces no Web, API, HTTP, authentication, authorization, or remote product service.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Introduction of any Web, API, HTTP, authentication, authorization, or remotely reachable product service; then select and document an ASVS level and verification scope.

gates.requiredScope: Reassess the distributable product dependency graph, SPDX SBOM, licence evidence, SLSA/provenance boundary, workflow action pinning and OpenSSF posture without claiming an unsupported assurance level.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After package, lock/pin, licence, workflow, builder, artefact, release, registry, or provider changes.

gates.requiredScope: Run a current direct and transitive vulnerability audit, record the VEX applicability decision for every known shipped finding, and block delivery on any unresolved critical vulnerability.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any advisory, dependency graph, SBOM, release, framework, or scan-date change.

gates.requiredScope: Produce G7/BSI AI-SBOM evidence for product models, datasets, inference infrastructure, system properties, security properties, and key performance indicators.
gates.rationale: AI is used as development tooling only; TinyCalc ships and operates no model, training or embedding dataset, inference service, or AI runtime component.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any model, dataset, inference service, AI runtime, or AI-dependent product capability becomes part of the shipped or operated system.

gates.requiredScope: Apply NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust architecture to the product runtime.
gates.rationale: The unchanged TinyCalc product is a local single-process TUI without distributed product identity, cloud, service, or network boundaries.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Introduction of a network, cloud, remote, service-based, managed, or identity-bearing product boundary.

gates.requiredScope: Assess Zero Trust principles for repository, CI, identity and provider delivery boundaries, including least privilege, exact-head identity, short-lived credentials and fail-safe denial; do not change provider configuration.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After repository host, CI, credential, identity, permission, branch policy, or remote-delivery changes.

gates.requiredScope: Create separate current BSI C3A cloud-autonomy and BSI C5 cloud-compliance applicability evidence for repository, CI and artefact providers without inferring N/A from the local product runtime.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After repository, CI, cloud, hosting, artefact-provider, contract, region, portability, or exit-strategy changes.

gates.requiredScope: Record separate current NIS2, CRA, EU AI Act, DORA and privacy applicability decisions plus OWASP SAMM follow-up, each with primary source, date, scope, owner, reviewer, trigger and residual risk; legal acceptance remains Human-only.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After market placement, customer delivery, regulated-sector use, cloud operation, AI runtime, personal-data flow, law/source update, audit, or incident.

gates.requiredScope: Prove DE-first/EN-second CEFR-B2 content, correct German umlauts and ß without ASCII substitutions, semantic Markdown, meaningful links, heading order, language parity, and text-complete WCAG 2.2 AA status/owner/dependency/follow-up evidence without colour or layout dependence.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any reader-facing text, table, link, status, navigation, image, example, or language-partner change.

gates.requiredScope: Regenerate DocFX because docfx.json includes changed docs/**/*.md, then execute a representative text-oriented HTML accessibility smoke with lynx and preferably Playwright/axe where the reviewed toolchain is available; absence of the preferred harness is recorded and cannot suppress the mandatory DocFX/lynx proof.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any Markdown, public API, XML comment, DocFX source/navigation/configuration, generated HTML, or accessibility-toolchain change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove the paired read-only validator contract, bilingual PowerShell help, approved Test-GsdbIntensiveReview Verb-Noun entry, Bash safety/parity and Bash 3.x compatibility, dedicated script-parity checklist, man page and actual Linux/Windows CI execution. WhatIf/dry-run is N/A only while both entrypoints remain non-mutating.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After validator, wrapper, help, man page, fixture, shell, parameter, or CI job changes.

gates.requiredScope: Measure changed product-code coverage with a 70 percent minimum and 80 percent target after observable product RED and GREEN tests.
gates.rationale: The accepted scope changes assessment evidence and its validator only; no TinyCalc product source or product test behavior is changed.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any change under src/ or to product behavior/tests; such a delta blocks until product TDD and coverage are planned and evidenced.

gates.requiredScope: Prove unchanged-product restore, Release build, full xUnit regression and exact single-line SMOKE_OK after repository version alignment and build-counter increment.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After source, test, project, version, dependency, environment, workflow, evidence-validator, or build-output changes.

gates.requiredScope: Record current direct/transitive, outdated and vulnerable NuGet results, justify every pinning exception, assess the observed absence or presence of Dependabot/Renovate and central Dependency-Track ingestion as owned follow-up, and prove no new dependency or known critical CVE enters delivery.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After dependency, SDK, framework, lock/pin, advisory, registry, licence, or release changes.

gates.requiredScope: Validate Documentation Impact UpdateRequired, reader-path discoverability, unchanged shared agent guidance, and current statistics with chronological ledger and refreshed ASCII trends using 80/125 line baselines and 7.8 hours per day.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After documentation, navigation, audience, distribution, shared guidance, statistics configuration, line count, or work-window changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove homogeneity, agent-secret scan, gitleaks, PowerShell static analysis, Bash safety/parity and absence of tracked runner profiles, secrets, private absolute paths, runtime logs or agent state.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After script, evidence, agent-surface, secret-rule, workflow, static-analysis, or delivery-set changes.

gates.requiredScope: Before every commit or push, align Version, AssemblyVersion and FileVersion to feature minor 5 with the prospective feature-branch commit count including the pending commit and an incremented build counter, validate the exact intended tracked/untracked delivery set read-only, stage only intended paths, and pass cached diff checks.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Before every commit/push and after any index, worktree, version, task, or intended-path change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove all required provider checks and current reviews converge on the exact PR head with no Changes Requested and no unresolved actionable thread; missing/refused/stale evidence is not a pass.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After every PR commit, base update, review, thread change, provider rerun, check change, or authority change.

gates.requiredScope: Use the authorised Admin-Bypass command for a sole remaining formal merge rule after every material technical, security, accessibility, governance, evidence and review gate has passed.
gates.rationale: Normal merge is preferred and no current exact-head provider evidence shows that the sole remaining blocker is a formal rule; bypass is not pre-authorised as a passing technical gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: At the exact reviewed head, all material gates pass and the provider reports only a formal merge-rule blocker. Update this requirement to Applicable, require token 'gh pr merge --merge --admin --delete-branch', re-review the changed head, and regenerate PreMerge evidence before use.

gates.requiredScope: Generate and validate a fresh temporary schema-2.0 PreMerge snapshot bound to the normalized accepted requirements hash and exact reviewed head, with exactly one Primary row per declared gate and no merge claim.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any requirement, gate, evidence, review, head, provider check, workflow, runner, command, or authority change.

gates.requiredScope: Merge normally, verify provider merge commit and parents, fast-forward local main, and validate schema-2.0 PostMerge evidence bound to the accepted PreMerge hash with empty changedPaths; no material gate may be bypassed.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Immediately before merge and after any authority, policy, head, provider, merge-commit, parent, PreMerge hash, or synchronization change.

gates.requiredScope: In the pre-named single-commit-capable causal evidence-only branch codex/005-gsdb-intensive-review-closeout, branch-stamp only the GSDB intake, update tinycalc-delivery exactly once with preserved lineage, validate manifest/receipt/review status in PowerShell and Bash, complete declared post-actions, fast-forward again, and close the run without starting another feature.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After feature merge, series/intake/review drift, closeout-head change, provider closeout result, post-action change, branch cleanup, or final synchronization change.

gates.requiredScope: Start a parallel autonomous campaign or any successor feature/intake as part of Feature 005 closeout.
gates.rationale: The accepted authority covers one serial GSDB feature only and explicitly forbids starting another feature or campaign.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: A new explicit user delegation names a separate eligible target or a bounded parallel campaign after Feature 005 has fully completed MergeAndSync.
